items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played on a couple of Lalo’s film scores in the trombone section.

ctx.x: . . . how he operated as a composer on a film project. One comes to mind. Ohhh. I can’t remember what it was now 'cause I played on two or three of Quincy’s film scores. I played on a couple of Lalo’s film scores in the trombone section. [It] was good to get to observe how they dealt with a film score.
And look at it from inside, too.
